decisions.quote: Consistent with Hypothesis 1, the DAM was positively associated with all attitudes. Partial support was found for Hypothesis 2, as the DAM was positively associated with several attitudes after controlling for other dispositions.
decisions.location: Study 1 Discussion of Findings, p. 6 (lines 967-969); also Study 2 Discussion of Findings, p. 8 (lines 1511-1514)
decisions.reason: The shipped 'failed' verdict relies on a truncated abstract quote about controlling for the NOSQ (an extension measure), whereas the replication hypotheses testing Hepler and Albarracín (2013) yielded full support for zero-order attitude associations (Hypothesis 1) and partial support for incremental validity controlling for other dispositions (Hypothesis 2).
